Story :

A story of what happened to Sebastian's father. And why Sebastian has strained relationship with Demetrius and Maru (it's getting better after the story is told). A couple of events,  some extra and revised dialog lines.

The story opens in spring, when you have at least seven hearts with  Robin, Demetrius and Sebastian. You happen to meet Sebastian at the lake on a Thursday or Friday evening....

A few days later you meet Demetrius at the fountain, and after that you get a letter from Sebastian.

The last part is played when fall comes.
